name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the required goal. Response(at_exit, holding_box) carries the box to the exit, since at_exit holds only on the last step. Response(box_fell, holding_box) makes the agent pick the box up again after each fall. All three are hard, none is redundant, and the machine's final state requires at_exit and holding_box.

texts: Reach the exit (the box must be carried at the exit step)
Whenever the agent reaches the exit, the box must be in the agent's hands at that point (carry the box to the exit)
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again, on that step or later
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3, u4
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box, u2) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u4) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box, u4) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u2, box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u4, holding_box, u3) -> 11
